entrees.en: The city adds up every director's blows. For the gauge, each strike is scaled to your Stratum (a newcomer counts as much as a veteran) and counts at most 3 shares.

entrees.fr: Chaque palier atteint revient à tous ceux qui ont frappé au moins une fois cette semaine. Le classement, lui, compte les dégâts purs. Tout repart à zéro le lundi.
entrees.en: Every tier the city reaches goes to everyone who struck at least once this week. The ranking, however, counts raw damage. Everything resets on Monday.
